source_name: IPCC 2006 Guidelines for National Greenhouse Gas Inventories, Volume 4 Chapter 5 (Cropland), section 5.5 (Methane emissions from rice cultivation)
read_from: Equations 5.1 to 5.3 (printed pages 5.45, 5.48, 5.50); Tables 5.11 and 5.12 (page 5.49), 5.13 (page 5.50) and 5.14 (page 5.51), read from the published pages

equations.5.1: CH4 (kg) = EF_i (kg CH4 per ha per day) x cultivation period (days) x harvested area (ha)
equations.5.2: EF_i = EF_c x SF_w x SF_p x SF_o
equations.5.3: SF_o = (1 + sum of ROA_i x CFOA_i) ^ 0.59

baseline_ef.unit: kg CH4 per ha per day
baseline_ef.note: Fields not flooded for less than 180 days before cultivation, continuously flooded during it, no organic amendments.

organic_amendments.rate_basis: tonnes per hectare: dry weight for straw, fresh weight for the others
